_help: Copy this file, rename it, edit it. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored. Run:  python jt_run.py solve cases/yourfile.json
name: my cooler
source: where these numbers come from (paper, table, your own design)
notes: free text, e.g. which inputs are assumed
_fluid_help: 'he3' = the CSV tables in data/he3/ ; or any CoolProp name such as 'Helium' (He-4) for a test
_T_C_help: cooling (evaporator) temperature [K]. Low-side pressure is taken as P_sat(T_C): no pressure drop
_T_pre_help: gas temperature leaving each precooling heat exchanger [K], warm to cold. One entry fewer than eta
_eta_help: effectiveness of each counterflow HX, warm to cold: eta = Q / Q_max, between 0 and 1
_d_um_help: JT orifice diameter [um]. Use null to get specific duties only (no mass flow, no Q_C). Discharge coefficient is 1

sweep._sweep_help: optional. Lists of values to scan (all combinations). Allowed: T_C, P_U, T_H, d_um, eta_last, T_pre_last

reported._reported_help: optional. Values the source reports, to compare against. Names: q_C_kJ_kg, mdot_mg_s, Q_C_mW, Q_pre1_mW, Q_pre2_mW, ..., T_JT_inlet_K, P_D_kPa
